tfn_mosi.attribution: MMSA's published numbers come from hyper-parameters selected on the TEST set. In MMSA/src/MMSA/run.py the tuning branch evaluates each candidate config with do_test(dataloader['test']) — the line that would use the validation set is commented out — and TFN's values in config_regression.json are one point of the search space in config_tune.json. A protocol that selects only on validation cannot match a test-selected optimum except by luck.
tfn_mosi.do_not_retry: Do not tune hyper-parameters against the test set to close this gap; that adopts the flaw. Do not re-investigate gradient clipping, epoch cap, use_bert, padding/pooling or the metric implementation — all four were tested and ruled out (see the investigation).
